svg.title: Cloud availability zones run by U.S. and Chinese providers in 37 third countries, October 2023
svg.desc: A chart of cloud availability zones in 37 countries other than the United States and mainland China: U.S. providers Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, 219; Chinese providers Alibaba, Huawei, and Tencent, 97, highlighted.
